facades.name: south-south-east front on Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat with the slate entrance tower
facades.note: Gemeente Amsterdam panorama 2023-03-06 (CC BY 4.0). Bands from the street: ground = 14 shopfronts + the glazed entrance under the canopy; storey 1 = 14 French windows (the tower is behind the canopy); storeys 2-3 (brick) and 4-5 (yellow brick) = 7 + 2 tower + 7; the tower carries one more pair above the parapet. Rooftop: only the slate tower rises over the parapet (the yellow corner blocks look higher only in perspective; 3DBAG has them at the 21.3 m main roof). depthBand 6 m: the canopy stands 4 m proud of the front.
